Quests.Pitch: You've grown into yourself, haven't you? I can change the blood you wear, if you still want a different kind of life. Bring what I ask. Once a week, mind you — the weave needs time to settle.

QuestDialogue.Line: A beggar lost a purse? The guards at the barracks were laughing about some poor fool…
What do you want? I don't keep gossip for travelers. If you're going to stand there, my time isn't free — or you can try your luck another way.
The plaza is only the doorstep. Walk the other halls, see what's posted, and speak with the people who keep this place running. Come back when you've had a look.
New around here? Browse all you like — no obligation to buy.
If you mean to study here, fetch ten essence from the mine below. Bring those to me and we can begin.
The feast is days away and my kitchens are in shambles. Ten baked potatoes, golden and crisp — and ten cooked crawfish beside them. Bring those to me and I shall not forget it.

If I'm going to open that shop I need a few things first. Rabbit's feet, fernleaf, wild berries, butterfly wings — five of each — and a thousand gold for the lease. Help me gather those and I can finally leave this kitchen.
Someone around town must have seen what happened. Ask anyone who'll listen — a shopkeeper, a passerby. Please, I have nothing else.
So someone talked. A purse? Maybe I saw something. Of course, my memory gets expensive… or you could try taking it.
He's downstairs more than he's in the shop. The mine under the tower is his domain — go introduce yourself.
Take five potatoes from the field here and bring them to me.
Those will do. The kitchen in town can cook them. Open the world map, go to Town, then the Kitchen.

Good. Equip your sword and shield, and keep potatoes in your food slot when you fight the cows here. Or if you want other skills first: the copper mine has fishing and mining, the meadow has hunting, and the kingswoods have woodcutting.
Helge is waiting at the old forge. She will tell you what the fire needs.
Twenty steel bars and a hundred coal. Then this place works again.
That will hold. Bring me 20 Steel Bars and 100 Coal, and the forge is yours.
The abandoned shaft is packed with rubble. Clear fifty piles in the Deep Mines, then walk the shaft.
Thanks for helping us. Now the dwarves can really start to rebuild our empire.
